items.prompt: For n=60, how does the function decide that the result needs no fraction bar?

options.text: 7*60 is even, so division by 2 gives the integer 210.
options.why: Seven is odd, so the numerator has the same parity as n.

options.text: Every sum of fair dice has integer expectation.
options.why: At n=1 the expectation is 7/2, not an integer.

options.text: The denominator can be dropped whenever the numerator exceeds 100.
options.why: Magnitude does not determine divisibility or a valid rational representation.
No sampling occurs. Exact integer arithmetic already determines the result.
